:::{#def-weighted-sum}
#### Weighted sum

A **weighted sum** of the [numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) $a_1, \ldots, a_k$
is a [linear combination](#def-linear-combination) of them,
with [coefficients](#def-lincom-coefficient) $w_1, \ldots, w_k$:

$$w_1 a_1 + \cdots + w_k a_k = \sumto{i}{k} w_i a_i$$

Multiply each $a_i$ by its coefficient $w_i$, then add.

:::
